content:
I'd like to discuss this comment from @Joël Riou about how to properly respond to the docs#linter.tacticAnalysis.verifyGrindOnly linter results. (Just moving to Zulip for visibility since this PR is now labeled as will-close-soon)

I completely agree that these are pointing out bugs in the grind tactic, and I have been trying to minimize and report these (see lean4#13877, lean4#13828, and lean4#13764). In the short term however, these proofs are very fragile in the sense that if they break, it is harder than expected to recover even the original correct proof from a previous commit. This is especially true as we gain more proofs that from their initial commit have used grind.

I think in the interim before these bugs are fixed in core, it would be nice to address these in some way. If the PRs I had started to open for this (#39808, #39769, #40022, #40023) that mostly squeeze to grind only are not appropriate, is there another recommended way to proceed?
